basic_info.description: Well maintained home in the desirable Mission Terrace neighborhood! Owner occupied by the same family for over 30 years, this beautiful home features a living room, a formal dinning room, a kitchen with breakfast nook and two bedrooms & one bathroom on the main level. On the ground level, there is a spacious garage, one bedroom & one bathroom with common area which can be used as another living room or convert into a kitchen. Separate entrance to downstair unit thru garage, ideal for rental, work from home and/or multi-generational lifestyle. Walking distance to Balboa Park, close to Glen Park area restaurants and shops; Open house Sat & Sun 8/24 & 8/25 from 1pm to 4pm;
